decisive_items: Papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores that are lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium
Shows mucin-containing goblet cells. Neither cytologic atypia nor atypical mitotic figures are present
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the histologic examination, including the presence of papillary fronds and mucin-containing goblet cells, which are characteristic of inverted papilloma. R3 is the runner-up because it also has some supporting evidence, but it lacks the distinctive features of inverted papilloma, such as the presence of mucin-containing goblet cells.

rejected.why: Lack of cytologic atypia or atypical mitotic figures makes it less likely
